## Evidence

<!-- Check the items that apply. Strong Reality-Probe PRs usually have at least two. -->

- [ ] Current upstream/version/commit is pinned
- [ ] Failure is reproducible before the change
- [ ] The same fixture passes or changes measurably after the change
- [ ] Machine-readable result/artifact is included
- [ ] Upstream-compatible regression fixture or patch is included
- [ ] External feedback / correction is linked
- [ ] This PR intentionally falsifies or narrows an earlier ContextMesh claim
